baslik: How Cladding Turned a Kitchen Fire Into a Tower Fire

sahneler.metin: Fire raced up the outside of a London tower block.
Within about half an hour it reached the roof, and seventy two people died.
It began with a fridge-freezer in one flat.
Flames escaped through the window into the building's cladding.
Its panels had a plastic core that burned like fuel.
Fire climbed the facade and entered flats from outside.
Residents had been told to stay put.
England then banned combustible cladding on tall homes.

aciklama:
Grenfell Tower was engulfed by fire from top to bottom. The cause: polyethylene-core aluminium composite cladding and cavity insulation spreading fire up the facade.
